what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Iran, where IDMC's data records mostly displacement by disasters, plus a conflict figure for 2025.
IDMC records 10000000 new displacements from conflict and violence in Iran in 2025, a yearly count of movements rather than people.
Refugees from Iran live mainly in Germany and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025, at war level in 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Iran, with PJAK and Jaish al-Adl among the government's opponents in 2018 to 2021, and Jaish al-Adl in 2023 to 2025.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Iran in IDMC's data.

when.text: The 2025 conflict figure falls in the same year that UCDP records the conflict with Israel at war level.
Disaster displacement was highest in 2019, when IDMC counted 178025 people still displaced by disasters at year end; by 2024 it counted 421.

how.text: IDMC gives no year-end total for people displaced by conflict in Iran, so the sources don't say how many people were still displaced at the end of 2025.
A new-displacement figure counts each forced move, so one person can be counted more than once.
